info.title: ExtraWork API
info.description:
WhatsApp-first contract-change and approval ledger.

Three surfaces: `/v1` (authenticated business), `/public/v1` (no-account customer approval), `/webhooks/v1` (provider callbacks). Money is always integer minor units. Quantities are decimal strings. Instants are ISO-8601 UTC.
